description: The run lock: .factory/local/lock.json, one entry per repository and branch a run can write (record lock, topic run-lock). Not tracked. Taken and released under the local/lock.flock file lock; refreshed by the hook runner through lock_seen at most once a minute. The schema requires every field of an entry.

scope.description: <repository>:<branches.integration>, the repository the run can write.

run.description: The run id that holds the lock.

subject.description: The holding run's subject; empty for a whole-cycle run.

session.description: The caller-marker session that took the lock.

taken.description: ISO 8601 UTC, whole seconds, ending Z: when the lock was taken (or taken over).

seen.description: When the holder was last seen alive; the hook runner refreshes it.
